roadmap.title: Normal story and Dark Knight ranks
roadmap.description: Start on Normal or Hard to unlock New Game Plus. Follow Worst Nightmare from the first tower onward and restart failed boss challenges before their fights end.

roadmap.title: Gotham cleanup
roadmap.description: Finish the datapacks, Most Wanted missions, Casefiles, upgrades and remaining open-world challenges on the original save.

roadmap.title: New Game Plus
roadmap.description: Complete the story again and finish any remaining Dark Knight ranks.

roadmap.title: I Am the Night
roadmap.description: Complete the unlocked permadeath story mode. Restart checkpoints before a death occurs.

roadmap.title: Batman challenge medals
roadmap.description: Earn Combat Training, Ranked, Custom and Campaign medals as Batman.

roadmap.title: Cold, Cold Heart
roadmap.description: Complete the paid story expansion. Protect the Bruce Wayne opening, scan the garage tag and finish indoor rescues and ice-wall takedowns before the finale.

roadmap.title: Restored multiplayer
roadmap.description: Official online services are closed. Set up Arkham Revived Self-Hosted, arrange an eight-player session for the full-lobby tasks and play Invisible Predator. Complete map wins before the XP persistence limit, then finish levels and prestige without closing the game.

guide.context: Interrogate green-highlighted Data Handlers to mark datapacks. Disable all seven GCR Towers and destroy the ten marked Network Relays in each district with Batarangs. Some packs need the Remote Claw, Shock Gloves or Glue Grenades; return after obtaining those gadgets. Packs below are numbered within each file for this checklist; use their location descriptions rather than the database grid position.

Hack the console beside the control-room doors. Cross the railings, destroy the weak wall with Explosive Gel and collect the trophy in the hidden room.

achievements.description: Complete a Most Wanted entry
achievements.summary: Finish one criminal's Most Wanted mission chain.

steps.text: After leaving the Final Offer, speak to the Anarky follower above the broadcast screen. Reach and disarm the first bomb on Gotham Merchants Bank's roof within three minutes.
Speak to Anarky's next followers in Diamond District and Coventry. Disarm the Gotham Casino and GCPD bombs before their timers expire, then defeat Anarky at the Abandoned Courthouse.

achievements.description: Capture all of Black Mask's Assassins
achievements.summary: Capture all eight of Black Mask's hired assassins.

steps.text: Defeat the six story assassins: Killer Croc, Deathstroke, Electrocutioner, Copperhead, Bane and Firefly.

Follow the SOS broadcast in the western Bowery and investigate the helicopter crash. After the Casefile closes, examine the bullet casing at the Hat Shop's southeastern corner and decode its radio frequency with the Cryptographic Sequencer. Follow Deadshot's invitation to Gotham Merchants Bank and defeat him there.
Follow the crying-baby signal in the Bowery's lower market to start Shiva's mission. Rescue the officer in Coventry's Shopping Complex, follow the blood trail and defeat Shiva in Wonder Tower.

achievements.description: Master the World's Greatest Detective Dark Knight track
achievements.summary: Finish the World's Greatest Detective track by filling 66% of the database.

steps.text: Progress the story, solve Casefiles and scan Anarky Tags and Cyrus Pinkney plaques. Each rank raises the database requirement by four percentage points, from 10% to 66%.

achievements.description: Complete all Dark Knight challenges
achievements.summary: Finish all sixty ranks across the four Dark Knight tracks.

guide.context: Dark Knight ranks remain completed when the save moves into New Game Plus. Preserve predator encounters for unfinished Worst Nightmare ranks; exhausting their remaining locations can require another playthrough.

steps.text: Finish Shadow Vigilante, Gotham Protector, Worst Nightmare and World's Greatest Detective on the same save.

achievements.description: Complete all Casefiles
achievements.summary: Resolve all nine Casefiles.

steps.text: Resolve the two story investigations, Coventry Tower Deathtrap and Lacey Towers Murders.

Follow the optional SOS broadcast in the western Bowery and investigate Helicopter Crash. Also respond to the six crime-scene broadcasts: Jezebel Plaza Fall; Dixon Docks Shooting; Coventry Fire; Burnley Hit & Run; Amusement Mile Mauling; Crime Alley Shootings.
At each scene, scan the evidence and rewind the reconstruction to find missing clues. When a Casefile identifies a suspect, track down and apprehend that suspect to close the case.

achievements.description: Stop 20 Crime in Progress
achievements.summary: Stop twenty Crimes in Progress.

steps.text: Respond to the random Crime in Progress broadcasts while exploring Gotham and defeat the attackers at twenty events.

achievements.description: Hear everything Alfred has to say
achievements.summary: Hear all of Alfred's wisdom conversations.

steps.text: After finishing the story and Most Wanted missions, speak to @npc{Alfred} in the Batcave until his conversation repeats.
Fast travel to Gotham and return to the Batcave to unlock another conversation. Keep visiting and speaking to Alfred until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.description: Obtain all the medals on Combat Training maps
achievements.summary: Earn all 36 medals in Batman's twelve Combat Training challenges.

steps.text: Open the challenge console in the Batcave and select Batman's @mechanic{Combat Training} maps.
Earn each map's three displayed medals. Complete the twelve training maps, including their gadget, counter, enemy-type and combo exercises.

achievements.description: Obtain all the medals on Custom maps in Challenge mode
achievements.summary: Earn all 72 medals on the original Custom challenge maps as Batman.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Custom} challenges as Batman and earn three medals on each original combat and predator map, including Extreme versions.
Leave negative modifiers disabled; Custom medals do not require them. Use helpful modifiers if needed, and ignore Downloaded Maps.

achievements.description: Acquire all upgrades
achievements.summary: Unlock all 59 of Batman's upgrades.

steps.text: Spend level-up points on every purchasable upgrade and complete all four Dark Knight tracks for their rewards.

Finish Most Wanted missions for their upgrade rewards, including Shiva's Critical Strikes and Black Mask's Increased Smoke Duration. Earn any remaining XP from fights and Crimes in Progress or continue in New Game Plus.

achievements.description: Reach x50 Combo
achievements.summary: Build a fifty-hit Freeflow combo.

steps.text: Fight a large group, such as the enemies after the Electrocutioner. Keep landing strikes and counters without taking a hit or letting the combo expire; cape-stun beatdowns help raise the counter.

achievements.description: Complete a predator encounter without ever being spotted
achievements.summary: Clear a predator encounter without being detected.

guide.context: The Theater is available while pursuing Penguin, before the Deathstroke fight.

steps.text: At the Final Offer's Theater, take out isolated armed enemies from behind. Restart Checkpoint immediately if spotted, before finishing the encounter.

achievements.summary: Perform one hundred takedowns on enemies who have not detected Batman.

steps.text: Use Silent Takedowns on unaware enemies throughout the story and New Game Plus. For remaining takedowns, return to the respawning armed guards on the GCPD roof or Final Offer deck.

achievements.description: Complete a predator encounter using only silent takedowns
achievements.summary: Clear a predator encounter using Silent Takedowns exclusively.

steps.text: At the second SIM-card objective in Industrial District, sneak behind each of the three armed guards and perform a Silent Takedown. Restart Checkpoint before finishing if you use another attack.

achievements.description: Glide across Bridge without touching ground
achievements.summary: Glide the full length of Pioneers Bridge without landing.

steps.text: Launch from a district outside @loc{Pioneers Bridge}, glide along the bridge and continue into the district at its opposite end. Use Grapnel Accelerator to regain height without landing.

achievements.description: Use the Batwing to travel to all Fast Travel points
achievements.summary: Arrive at every fast-travel destination using the Batwing.

steps.text: Unlock the GCR Towers, returning with the Disruptor and Shock Gloves for the later locks.
Use Batwing fast travel to each destination: Batcave, Coventry, Diamond District, Burnley, the Bowery, Park Row, Industrial District and Amusement Mile.

achievements.description: Successfully battle Shiva without taking any damage
achievements.summary: Defeat Shiva without losing health during her boss fight.

steps.text: Start Shiva's Most Wanted mission at the crying stroller in the Bowery's lower market. Rescue the officer in Coventry's Shopping Complex and follow the blood trail to Wonder Tower.
During Shiva's fight, counter the ninjas and use Special Combo Takedowns to remove them. Use Shock Gloves against Shiva and dodge her blade attacks in the later phase.
If any attack damages Batman, restart the checkpoint immediately while the fight is still active. Completing a damaged fight removes that retry opportunity.

achievements.description: Complete Deathstroke without failing a single counter
achievements.summary: Defeat Deathstroke without missing any counter prompts.

steps.text: During Deathstroke's Final Offer fight, counter each prompted attack and perform the beatdowns after his attack sequences.
If you miss a counter, restart the checkpoint before winning the fight. The completed fight cannot be replayed from that checkpoint.

steps.text: As Batman, earn three medals on each original @mechanic{Ranked} combat and predator map, including its Extreme version. Downloaded Maps are excluded.

steps.text: Select Batman's @mechanic{Campaign} challenges and collect all nine medals in each original three-map campaign.

Spend every required modifier across its three maps. Put combat penalties on combat maps you can handle and reserve helpful modifiers for the hardest map; complete each predator map's displayed objectives.

steps.text: Finish Enigma, Anarky, Penguin, Mad Hatter, Black Mask, Deadshot, Shiva and Bird.

steps.text: Finish a first story run on Normal or Hard to unlock @mechanic{New Game Plus}.
Select New Game Plus on the same save and finish the story again. Your upgrades and Dark Knight progress carry over, but counter icons are removed.

achievements.description: Finish I Am The Night Mode
achievements.summary: Finish the story in I Am the Night mode without dying.

steps.text: Complete New Game Plus to unlock @mechanic{I Am the Night}, then start that mode on the same save.
Play through the story and defeat the Joker. Pause and restart the checkpoint before Batman dies whenever a fight goes badly; a death deletes this mode's run.
During Firefly's airborne grapple sequence, keep pressing Counter through the two counter events even though prompts are absent.

achievements.description: Take down 6 different Elites in a match, using 6 different methods as Batman or Robin in multiplayer
achievements.summary: As Batman or Robin, defeat six different Elite players with six different takedown methods in one multiplayer match.

guide.context: Official multiplayer services have closed. Use Arkham Revived Self-Hosted (ARSH) to restore multiplayer: install its required .NET 7 Desktop Runtime, extract ARSH, choose Setup and select the game folder. Choose Server Panel, then Start, and leave ARSH running. Play Invisible Predator; Hunter, Hunted does not award these achievements.

steps.text: Arrange an eight-player Invisible Predator lobby, with six Elites and two Heroes. Play Batman or Robin.

Assign one different Elite to each method: Silent Takedown, Sonic Shock Batarang, Explosive Gel, Corner Takedown, Grate or Ledge Takedown, and Inverted Takedown. Complete all six in the same match; repeatedly defeating one Elite does not count.

achievements.description: Reach max level with the Joker faction in multiplayer

guide.context: Official multiplayer services have closed. Use Arkham Revived Self-Hosted (ARSH) to restore multiplayer: install its required .NET 7 Desktop Runtime, extract ARSH, choose Setup and select the game folder. Choose Server Panel, then Start, and leave ARSH running. Play Invisible Predator; Hunter, Hunted does not award these achievements. With ARSH, faction XP above 108,900 may persist only until the game closes. Get both factions near that value, then finish the level-30 grind and prestige without closing the game. Check saved progress in ARSH after matches. Change hosts between matches to prevent endless loading: have the host leave and rejoin while another player remains host. Recreate the lobby if the host does not change.

achievements.summary: Stop all four Anarky thug operations in Cold, Cold Heart.

At the final operation, hack the loudspeaker, then reach and disable the bomb on the Soder Cola roof before time runs out.

achievements.description: Get 3 enemies frozen in one attack
achievements.summary: Freeze at least three enemies with a single attack in Cold, Cold Heart.

steps.text: In Wayne Manor's Ballroom, keep the ordinary thugs alive and draw at least three into a cryogenic gunner's line of fire. Dodge the blast so it freezes the group.
If fewer than three freeze, evade over the frozen enemies to break the ice and set up another blast. Restart the checkpoint before clearing the fight if necessary.

steps.text: After receiving the XE Suit, enter myAlibi and stop on the railing overlooking the main room. Wait until both guards stand below the unstable stalactite, then charge and throw a Thermal Batarang at it.
If either guard gets back up, restart the checkpoint before leaving the encounter and try again.

achievements.description: Perform 3 ice wall takedowns
achievements.summary: Perform three ice-wall takedowns in Cold, Cold Heart.

guide.context: These two GothCorp encounters contain the available ice walls. Finishing the DLC without three takedowns requires a new DLC run.

steps.text: On the return visit to GothCorp, hide behind each of the two ice walls in the Organics Research Lab. Lure or wait for a guard to pass the opposite side, then use the prompted wall takedown.
During the final Mr. Freeze fight, use another ice wall for the third takedown. Restart the current checkpoint before finishing a fight if you have used too few walls.
